entries.body:
Progress so far: stages 1 and 2 of 3 released; stage 3 not yet advanced.

Stage 1 facts (carried from the prior summary):
- UPDATE.md:1-4: incident window 08:00-09:30 UTC. edge-gw began returning 5xx for returns-svc after a deploy.
- config/returns-svc.yaml holds repo defaults, which are overridden by the release notes:
  - clients.tax-engine.timeout_ms 2500 (line 7)
  - database.pool.max_size 48 (line 11)
  - acquire_timeout_ms 5000 (line 12)
  - cache.ttl_s 120 (line 14)
- deploy/deploys.log:3: 2031-04-19T08:16:14Z DEPLOY returns-svc build 6.33.4-cb27 (previous 6.32.5) at 100% by deploy-bot. Other deploys are unrelated.
- release-notes-6.33.4-cb27.md:
  - line 5: tax-engine timeout_ms 2500->750
  - line 19: db.pool.max_size 48->10 (to fit the shared-db connection quota)
  - line 21: ff-legacy-export removed (was 0%)
- stage-1 returns-svc.log:
  - First "timed out after 750ms" is line 161 (08:17:17.084Z).
  - First pool warning is line 193 (08:20:25.213Z): "db pool wait 1082ms (in_use 10/10)".
- stage-1 edge-gw 5xx line refs were never found. The stage 2 edge format is known now, so this is no longer needed.

Stage 2 (09:30-10:30 UTC):
- stage-2/deploy/changes.log:1: 2031-04-19T09:44:12Z CHG-5395 APPLIED returns-svc override clients.tax-engine.timeout_ms=4000 (was 750) by j.moreau; mitigation.
  - The tax-engine timeouts stopped, so the timeout hypothesis is superseded.
- changes.log:2: CHG-5396 PROPOSED fulfil-svc http.max_body_kb=512. Not applied and irrelevant.
- stage-2/ops/oncall-notes.md:
  - Line 5 (09:54): timeouts stopped, but 503s continue.
  - Line 6 (10:04): suspects db pool exhaustion but believes the yaml max_size 48. This is stale: the build default of 10 overrides the yaml.
- stage-2/logs/returns-svc.log:
  - Dominant ERROR: "db pool exhausted: 10/10 connections in use, waited 5000ms (acquire_ti...". There are 110 occurrences, the first at line 235.
  - The only 750ms timeouts are early lines (3, 4, 14, 16), before the mitigation.
- stage-2/logs/edge-gw.log:94: 09:46:32.224Z upstream=returns-svc GET /v1/cart status=503 rt=3.014s upstream_error="upstream returned 503".
- stage-2/metrics/returns-svc.csv (61 lines) has not been read yet. It is optional, for example to confirm pool in_use=10.

Current hypothesis:
- root_cause: DB_POOL_EXHAUSTED. Build 6.33.4-cb27 cut db pool max_size from 48 to 10, which is too small for load.
- required_value: 10, unless stage 3 has an APPLIED record changing it.
- remedy: RAISE_DB_POOL_LIMIT, for example an APPLIED override of db.pool.max_size back to 48. Note the release-notes concern about the shared-db connection quota.
- evidence_refs candidates:
  - symptom: stage-2/logs/returns-svc.log:235 (maybe a 235-254 range) and stage-2/logs/edge-gw.log:94
  - effective value: stage-1/deploy/release-notes-6.33.4-cb27.md:19
  - introducing change: release-notes:19 plus stage-1/deploy/deploys.log:3

Next steps:
- Advance to stage 3.
- Check for APPLIED or PROPOSED changes to pool.max_size. The later APPLIED record wins; PROPOSED records are ignored.
- Re-derive the effective value, the symptom lines and the refs, then answer.

[step 7] advance
thought: Stage 2 shifts to DB pool exhaustion (max_size 10 from release notes:19). Advance to stage 3.

Stage 3 of 3 released.
# Stage 3 of 3 (10:30-11:30 UTC)

Another change was applied (see stage-3/deploy/changes.log) and errors persist at a lower rate.
This is the final evidence stage. Give your final diagnosis once you have reviewed it.
